epic.intent: Ship provider-neutral role guidance that treats a worker as an engineer who can dispute an orchestrator's technical decision with evidence, while preserving the orchestrator's final in-scope coordination responsibility and the person's approvals. Before saving a plan, the planner records an environment/toolchain readiness matrix; before starting or claiming work, the orchestrator verifies the actual host/worktree and prepares missing authorized tools. The person authorizes project-local lockfile-pinned installs and user-level source-pinned tools named in a saved plan after publisher/integrity verification, while existing app installer confirmations remain mandatory. Global/admin installs, unknown publishers or integrity, unpinned downloads, consent/security-bypass commands and destructive offline reinstalls require a separate human decision. This is role guidance only: no runtime permission bypass, no product test/timeout changes, no blanket install. Coordinate with backlog card DM-793 (planner red-teaming) before editing skills/planner.md so the changes are integrated once. Evidence: board-conversations sprint 2 had successive missing Node/Git/PowerShell test launches; docs/runbooks/offline-development.md warns npm ci removes the existing offline tree; docs/runbooks/agents.md:44-48 requires native installer confirmation. One sprint ships the four role guides as usable MCP prompts; full DoD once on the final combined head at acceptance.

successCriteria.text: A worker can raise a specific evidence-backed disagreement to the orchestrator, receive a substantive decision and record a continuing safety/scope objection without being forced to mark the ticket met or contact the person directly.

A planner presents a concrete tooling/readiness matrix with exact commands, versions, sources, integrity, privileges, host and offline constraints before saving a plan; missing prerequisites become bounded preparation or a blocker rather than an optimistic claim.

An orchestrator checks the actual candidate head, dependencies and child-process environment before dispatch, installs only within the agreed authority boundary and explicitly reports what remains blocked.

The shipped planner, worker, collaboration and orchestrator prompts reflect the contract, preserve all existing human approvals and verification gates, and pass the project's Definition of Done on one combined candidate.

epic.title: Engineering dissent and tool-ready plans

bundle.rationale:
Outcome: four existing provider-neutral role prompts make worker-to-orchestrator technical discussion reciprocal and make tool readiness a verified entry condition, not a source of failed worker attempts. The person explicitly selected unattended project-local lockfile-pinned installation plus saved-plan-named, user-level, publisher/source/integrity-verified tools; existing app-level installer confirmation remains mandatory. Scope: `skills/worker.md`, `skills/collaboration.md`, `skills/planner.md`, `skills/orchestrator.md`; inspect existing fact files and MCP raw import, modify facts only if truly required. Non-goals: no machine-wide privileges, no arbitrary curl|shell, no native installer consent bypass, no automatic checkpoint/retry grant, no lowered checks/test timeout, no runtime authorization code. Evidence: board conversations sprint 2 recorded successive Node/Git/PowerShell setup failures (rn_01m7mx44w1mgqmy2bc02pbmt3y); `docs/runbooks/offline-development.md:12-24` warns `npm ci` destroys a working offline tree; `docs/runbooks/agents.md:44-48` requires human confirmation for vendor installers. Existing `skills/worker.md:9-13` encourages recommendations but never explicitly permits challenging the orchestrator; `skills/knowledge/orchestrator/claim-prerequisites.md` checks high-level prerequisites without an executable child-environment checklist. Decision: a worker can challenge once with evidence and reconsider on new evidence; orchestrator must answer substantively, owns the in-scope call and escalates genuine scope/safety/authority decisions. Planner verifies tool availability on named hosts if possible; unknown future host requirements become explicit sprint entry/pre-claim prep, never asserted ready. Dependency: worker/shared-policy and planner readiness may proceed independently; orchestrator response/readiness follows both for a consistent contract. External backlog card DM-793 also edits planner guidance; do not overwrite or duplicate its red-teaming protocol—coordinate its branch/standing before starting the planner ticket, or defer that ticket. One sprint yields usable MCP prompts and a human checkpoint; no artificial extra integration tickets. Verification: existing `src/mcp/skills.test.ts` targeted per worker, independent prompt inspection at acceptance, all six project DoD checks on one immutable head. Observed npm test was 344.92s: predeclare noninterruptible npm test and coverage as individually bounded 20-minute invocation exceptions to the ordinary ticket timebox, not changed test timeouts; failures remain failures, no rerun to green. The product should preserve unknown host/tool evidence as a blocker rather than claim readiness.
## Authorized corrective scope after Sprint 1 failed acceptance

The person authorized bounded corrective tickets after immutable c4be504 failed test and coverage (four tests each). Keep three accepted guide tickets and their prompt behaviors; the separate DM-793 card remains failed, not approved. In the current sprint, DM-803 and DM-804 are independent; DM-805 requires the accepted GO diagnosis; DM-794 acceptance remains the final join.

DM-803 moves lengthy preflight/dissent guidance into existing scoped facts, retaining the 800-word kernel and prompt vocabulary invariants rather than relaxing tests. DM-804 uses one safe isolated Windows junction probe; if no discriminating evidence within 5–10 minutes, report NO-GO and block DM-805 instead of churning infrastructure. DM-805 writes a regression only if the existing guard misses the cause; run targeted checks plus lint and typecheck after code changes.

No new global/admin installs, check skips, timeouts, or reruns of failed c4be504. The six project gates run once on a NEW immutable combined candidate after corrective tickets are reviewed. Human Save/adoption and checkpoint approval remain required before execution resumes; this draft authorizes no worker claims.

User-requested pre-execution prevention after the rejected acceptance: the prior narrow prompt tests missed the 800-word built-in kernel and backticked API vocabulary constraints, and the worker shell lacked PowerShell; the Windows junction failure needed an isolated safe probe, not another full-suite rerun. Revision 2 had already been saved/adopted before this request; this one focused redraft adds a <=10-minute GO/NO-GO ticket and dependencies before corrective claims. It uses existing tests and recorded failure output, not a new full gate or infrastructure scope; the saved checkpoint, human approval, and once-only gate on a new immutable candidate remain unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The worker guide explicitly permits evidence-backed disagreement and a proposed better solution without requiring agreement or permission to raise it.

The worker directs the challenge to the orchestrator, receives a reasoned response, preserves a persistent record for unresolved safety or unmet criteria, and never fabricates success or addresses the person directly.
The collaboration guidance preserves orchestrator and person authority while encouraging respectful reciprocal engineering discussion.

tickets.body:
## Outcome
Give-and-take, not deference: a worker may challenge an orchestrator’s proposed implementation, scope interpretation, verification strategy or technical decision when evidence conflicts. Send the facts, alternatives, tradeoffs and a recommendation; invite a substantive answer. The orchestrator owns the in-scope decision and explains it, but the worker can present new evidence once and ask for reconsideration. A continuing safety, authority, or unmet-criterion objection remains recorded and the worker reports incomplete rather than pretending to agree. Do not contact the person directly, issue an unbounded argument loop, change the plan or ignore a final authorized decision.

## Source locations
- `skills/worker.md`, Questions and decisions/Blockers/Comments: explicitly allow reasoned disagreement and respectful challenge with a record and resolution path.
- `skills/collaboration.md`, Delegated workers and reviewers: clarify reciprocal engineering discussion without changing the orchestrator’s formal authority or human escalation boundary.
- Inspect `skills/knowledge/orchestrator/worker-questions.md` for consistency; orchestrator reply wording belongs to the dependent orchestrator ticket.

## Tests
None to add: Markdown role guidance, no executable behavior. Run the existing `src/mcp/skills.test.ts` prompt/skill suite as targeted verification; do not add source-text echo tests. Full Definition of Done only at sprint acceptance.

reasoning.rationale: Worker disagreement and coordination authority must be consistent across two role guides.

tickets.body:
## Outcome
Before Save, identify and check actual toolchain needs for the plan: named target host/OS, repo and branch, Node/npm and lockfile dependencies, exact commands with versions, child-process PATH tools, SDK/native permissions, fixtures, offline/network availability, source/publisher/integrity, install location/privilege, consent and a finite preparation/verification estimate. Demonstrate available prerequisites on the named host where feasible; if the worker or host is not yet known, record an explicit entry prerequisite and bounded pre-run setup rather than claiming it is ready. A plan does not itself grant OS privileges.

## Authority
The person authorized unattended project-local, lockfile-pinned installs and saved-plan-named user-level source-pinned tools after publisher/integrity verification. Existing native app installer confirmations remain mandatory; global/admin, unpinned, integrity-unknown or unsafe installs require a separate human decision. Never destroy an existing offline node_modules with speculative npm ci; docs/runbooks/offline-development.md:12-24 spells out the hazard. Make checks proportional to actual plan, not a generic massive installation ritual. Coordinate with backlog card DM-793 before editing the shared planner guide; do not overwrite its red-teaming change or report a pending card as delivered.

## Source locations
- `skills/planner.md`, Orient/Clarify outcome/Break into tickets/Validate and hand over: add the matrix and evidence/permission boundary at natural planning points.
- `docs/runbooks/offline-development.md` and `docs/runbooks/agents.md`: inspect existing offline and vendor-confirmation boundaries; do not change them.

## Tests
None to add: Markdown instructions only. Run existing `src/mcp/skills.test.ts` targeted; full Definition of Done at sprint acceptance.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The orchestrator checks exact saved-plan source, actual host/worktree and required child-process tools before start or claim; missing prerequisites block dispatch rather than become worker failures.

Only preauthorized project-local and verified saved-plan user-level installs are unattended; existing installer confirmation, offline preservation and separate human decisions for global/admin or unverifiable installs are kept.

tickets.body:
## Outcome
Before start_run and each claim, reconcile the saved plan’s tooling matrix with the actual host, worktree and exact candidate HEAD: needed dependencies/version, Node/npm/Git and other child executables in the launch shell, OS/SDK and privilege/fixture requirements, internet/offline state, finite gate duration, accepted consent and install scope. Prepare absent project-local lockfile-pinned dependencies or saved-plan-named source/integrity-verified user-level tools when authorized; honor native installer confirmation, preserve offline installs, never use admin/global or unknown integrity without a human decision. If readiness cannot be demonstrated, do not claim; record missing prerequisite and take the sanctioned plan/recovery path.

Treat a worker’s evidence-backed objection as engineering input: assess the cited facts and alternatives, give a reasoned decision in the ticket record, reconsider when new evidence materially changes the case, and never demand false criterion claims or silence a safety concern. Own the final in-scope call and human escalation.

## Source locations
- `skills/orchestrator.md`, Rules and setup/loop: place the pre-start and per-claim checklist and reciprocal decision protocol without diluting safety gates.
- Inspect `skills/knowledge/orchestrator/claim-prerequisites.md`, `setup.md` and `worker-questions.md` for consistency; edit an existing fact only if the role guide cannot carry the concrete rule, and preserve skill-version/test obligations if changing knowledge.
